validation-1.3.17.reason: CEN release 2026-10-09 (milestone '1.3.17 (Nov-26)'). The XRechnung validator configuration of KoSIT, which defines the rule sets of every XRechnung/EN16931 scenario, still pins cen.rules.version 1.3.16 (release v2026-08-31 and master bd160dc19ba7, build.xml line 73). Adopting 1.3.17 before KoSIT would break parity with the official validator; it is adopted with the KoSIT configuration release that switches to it.

v3.0.20.reason: OLDER than the pinned version: GitHub release 'BIS version 3.0.20: 2025 November Release' (tag commit 261c458474e2 on master, 2026-03-16). The pinned commit 806866bd2bd9 (branch 2026-Q2-QA2, 2026-06-10) is release 3.0.21 ('Last update: 2026 May release 3.0.21.' in PEPPOL-EN16931-UBL.sch; docs.peppol.eu/poacc/billing/3.0/release-notes/: Version 3.0.21, publication 2026-05-20, mandatory from 2026-08-17), which has no tag on GitHub; KoSIT xrechnung-schematron 2.6.0 takes the Peppol rules from this branch head. v3.0.20 is no ancestor of the pin because OpenPeppol prepares each release on quarter branches. A tag v3.0.21 or later is not listed here and turns the check red.
